001: Ivan, I recently moved into a new apartment. Do you want to see the photos?
Of course, show me! I was just thinking about changing my place too.
Here's the living room. It's pretty spacious, and you can see the park from the window.
It looks very cozy. And is the kitchen big?
The kitchen is small, but modern. It has all the necessary appliances.
Sounds great. And how many rooms are there in your apartment?
002: Dmitry, where do you live now? In the center or outside the city?
I'm renting an apartment not far from the university, in a quiet neighborhood.
That's convenient. And is the building old or new?
The building is new, it's only five years old. It has an elevator and an underground parking lot.
Great! And are your neighbors noisy?
No, the neighbors are quiet. We even say hi to each other in the elevator sometimes.
003: I really like my room. I redecorated it in light colors.
That must have been difficult. And what did you change first?
I painted the walls a warm beige color and replaced the old wardrobe.
Great. And did you buy new furniture or keep the old ones?
I bought a new sofa and a desk. Now the room looks completely different.
I can imagine how beautiful it is now. I'll have to come visit!
004: Sergey, tell me about your house. Do you live in a private house or an apartment?
We live in a small private house outside the city. There's a garden and a garage.
How nice! And in winter, it must be expensive to heat a house like that?
We have good heating, so it's warm and comfortable at home in winter.
And in summer, it must be nice to sit in the garden?
Yes, in summer we often have lunch on the terrace. It's very pleasant.
005: I'm looking for a new apartment, but nothing fits so far.
And what are your requirements for a place?
I need a two-bedroom apartment with a balcony and good soundproofing.
I see. And does the neighborhood matter?
Yes, I'd like there to be shops and a park nearby.
I hope you find what you're looking for soon. Good luck!
006: Alexey, how do you like your new studio? Have you settled in yet?
Yes, I got used to it in a couple of weeks. Though, it's very small.
But at least you have your own little corner in the city center now.
That's true. I like that everything is close by: both work and cafes.
And what about the furniture? Have you arranged everything?
Almost. I just need to hang the shelves in the kitchen, and everything will be ready.
007: Maria, what kind of home do you have? You said you live with your parents.
Yes, we live in a three-room apartment on the fifth floor.
And do you have your own room?
Of course, I have a separate room. I love it very much.
And what's it like? Is it big?
Not very big, but bright. There's a large window facing the courtyard.
008: Olga, I heard you're moving. Is that true?
Yes, I found an apartment closer to work. Now I don't have to spend an hour commuting.
That's wonderful! And what's the apartment like?
It's a one-bedroom, but with a very convenient layout. The kitchen is combined with the living room.
And is the view from the window good?
Yes, the windows face the embankment. It's very beautiful there in the evening.
009: Elena, have you ever lived in a dormitory?
Yes, in my first year I lived in a dormitory. It was an interesting experience.
Really? And what was it like there? Were the rooms big?
The rooms were small, for two people. But it was a lot of fun.
And were the facilities in the room or on the floor?
There was a shared kitchen and shower on the floor. Now, of course, I live in an apartment and don't regret it.
010: Dmitry, I'm thinking about rearranging the furniture in the living room. What do you think?
That's a good idea. And what exactly do you want to change?
I want to put the sofa by the window and move the TV to the other wall.
Sounds reasonable. That way the room will seem bigger.
You're right. And I also want to add more light.
You could hang a mirror opposite the window. That will visually increase the space.
